A1.justification: Both complete, readable 12-page PDFs describe the same DPE research and include the main text, equations, figures, tables, references and Appendix A. Pages 2–12 render identically; differences are confined to first-page authorship and version/date information.

before.justification: v1 reports original DPE experiments on two Qwen backbones across eleven benchmarks, alongside ablations, generated-data diversity and quality evaluations, and Appendix A's qualitative comparisons.

after.justification: v2 retains those original experimental results in Section 4, Tables 1–5 and Appendix A. Results retained from v1 still constitute original empirical evidence.

M1.justification: Sections 3.1–3.4 retain the same diagnostic mechanism, four-agent generation system, image retrieval/editing, validation, difficulty filtering and GRPO training procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions use Vision-SR1-47K seed data and the same eleven evaluation benchmarks covering STEM, visual mathematics, OCR, multi-image understanding and hallucination. No dataset or task scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: The table-specific comparator sets are identical: base models and VisPlay in Table 1, the same six comparison models in Table 2, Vision-R1 in Table 3, and VisPlay in the diversity, quality and appendix comparisons.

E3.justification: The backbones, three evolution rounds, training-data budgets and accuracy evaluation remain unchanged. The diagnostic, diversity and question-quality evaluations retain their stated 200-example samples and procedures.

E4.justification: Both retain the static-training comparison, diagnostic and image-tool ablations, category-mixture analysis, diversity and question-quality analyses, and Appendix A's two qualitative cases. None is added, removed or revised.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting is identical, including point estimates and diversity/quality averaging procedures. Neither version supplies repeated-run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals or significance tests.

E6.justification: All numerical entries, plotted results and qualitative examples are unchanged. For example, Table 1 retains iteration-three DPE averages of 59.29 for Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct and 68.04 for Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, GRPO objective and maximum-entropy reasoning are identical, including the policy, soft-value and KL-bound expressions in Equations (13)–(18). No assumption, derivation or proof is revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same claims about diagnosis-guided evolution, data efficiency, training stability and long-tail capability improvement.

C2.justification: The explanations linking targeted data mixtures and visual diversity to training stability and performance remain unchanged. Appendix A's interpretations and the Impact Statement's risk qualifications are also identical.

D1.justification: Section 4.1 retains the same agent models, Serper top-three image retrieval, Qwen-Image-Edit and diagnostic sampling details. The abstract provides the same code, model and data repository link.

R1.justification: Section 2, the references and the positioning relative to prior self-evolving multimodal methods are unchanged. No cited work or novelty relationship is added or removed.

P1.justification: v2 adds Yongrui Heng to the author list and updates the preprint date and arXiv version/date stamp. The scientific prose, terminology, section order and appendix text are otherwise identical.

P2.justification: Figures 1–6 and Tables 1–5 retain identical content, captions, formatting and placement, including Appendix A's Figure 6. Page organization is unchanged; first-page differences concern bibliographic text.

improvement.justification: v2 changes authorship and version/date information while preserving the scientific content and exposition, including all results and Appendix A. These edits establish no meaningful improvement or deterioration in the paper's evidence, reasoning, clarity or reproducibility.
